shapes.name: TextBox 22
shapes.text:
• Lumvoa: FDA approved 2026-06-26 for TED regardless of activity/duration; regional access remains separate.
• IGF-1R TED evidence/authorization을 GD pathogenic autoimmunity 제거 또는 durable remission으로 전환하지 않는다.
• LCA-0321·MER511은 direct anti-TSHR Phase 1 hypotheses; evidence confidence는 각각 Low, Low–moderate.
• TERMINATED·WITHDRAWN·SUSPENDED·UNKNOWN trials와 target-unverified assets를 그대로 유지했다.
• Control, off-treatment remission, ablation/surgery, cure를 구분한다.

shapes.name: SOURCE_FOOTER_03
shapes.text: Canonical registry_cut_reconciliation_2026-09-10.json, qa_summary.json, clinical_trials_v2.csv +2  •  Complete claim/row map: slide_source_map_v2.csv

shapes.name: TextBox 26
shapes.text:
• Frozen ClinicalTrials.gov cut와 deterministic inclusion logic을 사용했다.
• All statuses retained; stopped/unknown은 누락이나 mechanistic failure로 자동 분류하지 않았다.
• n_randomized와 n_analyzed는 registry flow 및 endpoint-specific denominator semantics를 보존했다.
• Meta-analysis·naïve pooling·cross-trial ranking을 수행하지 않았다.
• Claim QA는 동일 coordinator의 stance-hidden second pass이며 independent validation이 아니다.

shapes.name: TextBox 23
shapes.text:
• TED PRR·CAS·diplopia·GO-QOL은 GD biochemical remission endpoint와 교환 가능하지 않다.
• RAI/thyroidectomy는 pathogenic autoimmunity 또는 TED 소실을 자동 의미하지 않는다.
• ‘Cure’는 normal thyroid function + pathogenic autoimmunity의 지속적 소실 + treatment-free durability를 요구한다.

shapes.name: TextBox 18
shapes.text:
• Mechanism hypothesis: anti-TSHR autoantibodies를 선택적으로 결합·lysosomal elimination하도록 설계.
• Sponsor intent: general immunosuppression 없이 pathogenic driver 제거.
• Required readouts: safety/PK/PD, TRAb/TSI/TSAb kinetics, thyroid hormones, ADA·immunogenicity, total IgG.
• Frozen package에는 human efficacy, rebound, normal TSH physiology preservation, TED–biochemical concordance 또는 off-treatment durability를 확립한 result가 없다.

shapes.name: TextBox 18
shapes.text:
• Mechanism hypothesis: anti-TSHR autoantibody neutralization/clearance + antigen-specific B-cell function 억제.
• Construct: engineered TSHR ectodomain–mutant Fc fusion precision biologic.
• TSH non-binding, TSH-signaling preservation, total-IgG sparing은 sponsor/preclinical claim이며 human-validated가 아니다.
• Protocol objectives는 safety, tolerability, PK, PD, immunogenicity; frozen registry에 posted results가 없어 clinical efficacy와 durable remission은 미확정이다.
